text: Proudly Endorsed by the San Marcos Professional Firefighters, San Diego & Imperial County Labor Council, and the American Federation of Teachers.

My name is Justin Matsushita, and I recently retired as the Fire Chief with the City of Santee after almost three decades of leadership in public safety and emergency management. I hold a PhD in Fire and Emergency Management Administration and a Master of Public Administration, and I have lived in every district in the City of San Marcos. I bring executive leadership experience, proven fiscal stewardship, a commitment to public service, and a lifetime of local knowledge of our community.
My wife and I met at San Marcos High School, raised our two sons here, and we remain deeply committed to the community that is home to four generations of the Matsushita family.

Beyond my professional career, I have served as Board Chair and Treasurer of Project Next, President of the California Fire Chiefs Association Emergency Management Section, an appointed member of the City of San Marcos Measure Q Citizens’ Oversight Committee, and a passionate supporter of the Boys & Girls Club of San Marcos.

If elected, I will provide experienced, transparent, and fiscally responsible leadership focused on public safety, thoughtful growth, infrastructure, and protecting the quality of life that makes the City of San Marcos a wonderful place to live, work, and raise a family.

text: As a longtime San Marcos resident, mother of three daughters, and Business Professional, I’m running for San Marcos City Council to keep our community safe, well-managed, and a great place to live.

For years, I’ve worked to improve our Community. I serve as President of the San Elijo Hills Community Association and founded our Fire Safe Council to strengthen wildfire preparedness, reduce homeowners’ insurance costs, and protect the long-term insurability of our Communities.
As a San Marcos Planning Commissioner, I support Smart Growth that Protects our Quality Of Life.

As a CSU San Marcos graduate and Regional Facility Manager for a national software company, I managed budgets, capital improvement projects, infrastructure, and operations across the western United States. I understand how to solve problems, balance priori ties, and make responsible financial decisions.
My priorities: protect public safety, manage growth responsibly, improve traffic and infrastructure, maintain parks and open space and ensure transparent, accountable government.

I believe local government works best when leaders listen first, are accessible to the people they serve, put Community ahead of politics, and make common sense decisions. If elected, I promise to respect your time, tax dollars and peace of mind.
I’m honored to be endorsed by Mayor Rebecca Jones, the Deputy Sheriffs’ Association of San Diego County, and California School Employees Association.
I humbly ask for your vote. Smith4SanMarcos.com | 760-877-1739
